newsitem.title: USA: Inter-Tel tops AEA stock growth roster.
newsitem.headline: Inter-Tel tops AEA stock growth roster.

text.p: The American Electronics Association said Inter-Tel Inc led its "Top Five" growth list for companies presenting annually at its Monterey Classic financial conference over the past five years.

Inter-Tel shares rose by 2,557 percent, or 22.37 points to $23.25 a share from an adjusted $0.88 a share, while the average share price of five-year participants in the conference rose by 307.17 percent, the AEA said.
The high tech trade association traditionally releases its list of top five-year performers at the start of its four-day conference. This year, some 350 companies are presenting.
Voice and data communications company Tellabs Inc ranked second in five-year performance, with a rise of 2,092 percent over the period, gaining $75.4 a share to $79 from $3.60 five years ago.
Networking powerhouse Cisco Systems was third ranked, rising 1,470 percent to $65 a share from a split- adjusted $4.14 at the start of the five-year period.

Computer connector company Adaptec Inc improved on its five-year performance by 1,320 percent, or 57.75 points, to $62.12, while Aspect Technologies Corp, a manufacturer of phone call processing systems, rose 1,110 percent to $58.25 from an adjusted $4.81, the AEA said.
